## Core Innovation
The paper introduces a novel cross-band modulation framework that integrates 3D RF modulation with intensity modulation and direct detection (IM/DD) in optical systems, enabling efficient and spectrally efficient communication.

## Technical Approach

- **Intensity Modulation**: Employs IM in the optical domain for efficient signal transmission.
